item.title: Undergraduate Researcher
item.description:
As a participant in the QI AI Research Program, I first completed a hands-on training track using KNIME, a no-code machine learning platform, to build foundations in end-to-end ML workflows — data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.

I then led a team research project as first author of the paper “Development of Machine Learning Models for Spatio-Temporal Pattern Analysis of High-Volume For-Hire Vehicle Demand in Manhattan.” The study proposes a grid-based hourly demand forecasting framework for ride-hailing services (Uber, Lyft) using Random Forest Regression trained on NYC TLC trip records and Open-Meteo weather data. By re-partitioning Manhattan into a uniform 14×8 grid (34 valid cells), we addressed the spatial inconsistency of conventional taxi zones and modeled non-linear spatio-temporal demand patterns with cyclic time encodings and 24-hour lag features.

item.title: Member
item.description: Over the two years I have been working as a member of the Yonsei Computer Club, I have participated in different projects and study groups to deepen my knowledge in computer science. I learned the basic grammar structure of database-managing tools—such as MongoDB and SQL—and I am currently participating in a deep learning study group to explore new fields of computer science. Last year, I participated in the SKYST Hackathon with members of the club and designed the UI of a social networking application.

item.title: Prompt Engineer
item.description: During my service at Outlier AI, I was assigned to different prompt engineering projects. I created coding-related prompts that involved code generation, solution reasoning, etc., and evaluated the model’s response to improve its quality. I was later asked to review prompts by other engineers to make sure that AI models were receiving solid prompts.

item.title: Work-Study Student
item.description: While taking the Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) course, I provided academic and personal assistance to a visually impaired student. I helped him navigate to the classroom, ensured he could listen to the lectures comfortably, and transcribed lecture materials into an accessible format to support his learning.

item.title: Animal Shelter Volunteer
item.description: During the summer break of 2024, I have went to volunteer at an animal shelter in Yongin Special City. Once in every two weeks, I have walked shelter dogs to improve their well-being and happiness. I cleaned the shlter facilities to maintain a sanitary environment.

item.title: Member
item.description: As a member of the Yonsei Student Advisory Council (YSAC), I coordinated various projects aimed at enhancing student well-being on the Songdo Campus. I organized a campus-wide language exchange program that fostered international interaction and cross-cultural understanding. During the Yon-Ko Games season, our council hosted a slogan contest, and I took the initiative to contact multiple companies to design and produce the winning slogans.

item.title: Little Eagle Intern
item.description: Under the Little Eagle Internship Program organized by Yonsei University’s Higher Education Innovation (HEI) initiative, I completed an internship at Deltoid, a medical metaverse startup. During the internship, I helped design the user interface of a medical metaverse application that enables customers to communicate with doctors in an intuitive and accessible virtual environment.
